lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਦੇਹ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਤੇਰਉ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: asathir jo maanio deh so tau terau hoi hai kheh ||
lines.translation: You believed that this body was permanent, but it shall turn to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kiu na har ko naam lehi moorakh nilaaj re ||1||
lines.translation: Why don't you chant the Name of the Lord, you shameless fool? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਏ ਆਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat heee aan chhaad de tai man ko maan ||
lines.translation: Let devotional worship of the Lord enter into your heart, and abandon the intellectualism of your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jan ih bakhaan jag mahi biraaj re ||2||4||
lines.translation: O Servant Nanak, this is the way to live in the world. ||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok sahasakritee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok Sehskritee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਿ ਪੁਸ੍ਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRhi pustak sa(n)dhiaa baada(n) ||
lines.translation: You study the scriptures, say your prayers and argue;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
lines.translation: you worship stones and sit like a crane, pretending to meditate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh jhooth bibhookhan saara(n) ||
lines.translation: You speak lies and well-ornamented falsehood,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
lines.translation: and recite your daily prayers three times a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaata(n) ||
lines.translation: The mala is around your neck, and the sacred tilak mark is on your forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dui dhotee basatr kapaata(n) ||
lines.translation: You wear two loin cloths, and keep your head covered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
lines.translation: If you know God and the nature of karma,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚੈ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh phokat nisachai karama(n) ||
lines.translation: you know that all these rituals and beliefs are useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਚੌ ਧੵਿਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak nisachau dhyiaavai ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord with faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur baat na paavai ||1||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸੵ ਜਨਮਸੵ ਜਾਵਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihaphala(n) tasy janamasy jaavad braham na bi(n)date ||
lines.translation: The mortal's life is fruitless, as long as he does not know God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸੵ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagara(n) sa(n)saarasy gur parasaadee tarahi ke ||
lines.translation: Only a few, by Guru's Grace, cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
lines.translation: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful. Thus speaks Nanak, after deep deliberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
lines.translation: The Creation is under the control of the Creator. By His Power, He sustains and supports it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog sabada(n) giaan sabada(n) bed sabada(n) ta braahamanah ||
lines.translation: The Shabad is Yoga, the Shabad is spiritual wisdom; the Shabad is the Vedas for the Brahmin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੵਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: khytree sabada(n) soor sabada(n) soodr sabada(n) paraa kritah ||
lines.translation: The Shabad is heroic bravery for the Khshaatriya; the Shabad is service to others for the Soodra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sabada(n) ta ek sabada(n) je ko jaanas bheu ||
lines.translation: The Shabad for all is the Shabad, the Word of the One God, for one who knows this secret.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ko daas hai soee nira(n)jan deu ||3||
lines.translation: Nanak is the slave of the Divine, Immaculate Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨੰ ਤ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek krisna(n) ta sarab devaa dev devaa ta aatamah ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Divinity of all divinities. He is the Divinity of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮੰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਾਸ੍ਵਦੇਵਸੵ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatama(n) sree baasvadevasy je koee jaanas bhev ||
lines.translation: Nanak is the slave of that one who knows the Secrets of the soul and the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ko daas hai soee nira(n)jan dev ||4||
lines.translation: He is the Divine Immaculate Lord Himself. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok sahasakritee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok Sehskritee , Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤੰਚ ਮਾਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: kata(n)ch maataa kata(n)ch pitaa kata(n)ch banitaa binod sutah ||
lines.translation: Who is the mother, and who is the father? Who is the son, and what is the pleasure of marriage?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤੰਚ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਬੰਧਵ ਕਤੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੵਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kata(n)ch bhraat meet hit ba(n)dhav kata(n)ch moh kuta(n)byte ||
lines.translation: Who is the brother, friend, companion and relative? Who is emotionally attached to the family?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤੰਚ ਚਪਲ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰੂਪੰ ਪੇਖੰਤੇ ਤਿਆਗੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kata(n)ch chapal mohanee roopa(n) pekha(n)te tiaaga(n) karot ||
lines.translation: Who is restlessly attached to beauty? It leaves, as soon as we see it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੰਤ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਤਨਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raha(n)t sa(n)g bhagavaan simaran naanak labadhy(n) achut tanah ||1||
lines.translation: Only the meditative remembrance of God remains with us. O Nanak, it brings the blessings of the Saints, the sons of the Imperishable Lord. ||1||
